thread:
alex: Quick sync — Equinox Edge marketplace listing is targeting a public announcement on 2026-04-28. We need a clear artifact scope (SOC/pen/questionnaire/firmware attestations) and who owns each item. Timeline is tight.

mira: Thanks. Can we lock down which SOC report level they expect (SOC 2 Type II vs Type I)? Also need to confirm attestation dates so our compliance team can validate timestamps.

alex: Partner asked for SOC 2 Type II, rolling 12 months preferred. Equinox said they have a recent pen test (Jan 2026) but want us to accept a redacted version. They also mentioned hardware firmware attestation for their gateway.

samir: Redacted pen tests are fine if we get the full scope and vuln tracker export. Need: 1) SOC 2 summary + cert 2) pen test report (redacted ok) + vuln export CSV 3) firmware attestation PDF + signing cert 4) completed marketplace questionnaire (we require answers for data flows and key management).

jordan: Noted. Who will own the presigned artifact upload flow? Equinox is S3-backed but asks us to provide upload instructions + presign window. Also we should define what we consider PII in artifacts to avoid oversharing.

claire: I can coordinate the presign links from our ingest bucket. Suggested approach: provide a single presign per artifact bundle that expires in 72h, and request SHA256 checksums. Sample presign command I can send:

```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-partner-ingest/equinox/2026-04-XX/bundle.tar.gz --expires-in 259200
```

mira: For PII: redact customer emails, IP addresses tied to identifiable customers, and screenshots with tokens. Provide a redaction checklist to Equinox. We'll accept a "clean" bundle and a separate sealed vault for unredacted items for internal audit (if partner agrees).

samir: For the pen test, we need the CVE mapping and whether critical/high issues were remediated. If not fully remediated, must include mitigation plan and temporary compensating controls. Also request STIG/firmware signature chain details for the gateway attestation.

alex: Action items so far: 1) claire -> presign flow + template (ETA EOD 2026-04-18) 2) samir/mira -> artifact checklist + redaction checklist + acceptance criteria (ETA 2026-04-19) 3) jordan -> confirm partner will provide vuln CSV and attestation cert (ETA 2026-04-18) 4) alex -> coordinate announcement blackout window with comms (we need 48h embargo before public).

jordan: Also flagging SI integration: the SI requires an integration test witness window. They want live test creds for 2 hours. We should require a scoped cred with audit logs forwarded to us. Anyone opposed?

mira: Fine with witness tests if creds are scoped and logs ship to our audit project. Add requirement for one Redwood engineer during the window for verification.

claire: I'll include the log-forwarding details and token TTL guidance in the upload template.

deploy-bot: Reminder: any public listing changes must be gated through release process. Create a release issue and tag #release-war-room.

alex: Good point — I'll open the release issue after we have artifacts committed. Final ask: can everyone ack these AIs in thread by EOD tomorrow? We need to present the ingestion plan to Equinox on Monday. :thumbsup:
